{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Pasta Recipes|Pasta Recipes]]

Pasta tossed with spices and vegetables from the Southwest United States.

==Ingredients==
*12 [[Cookbook:Ounce|oz]] seashell (or other) [[Cookbook:Pasta|pasta]]
*2 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] [[Cookbook:Olive Oil|olive oil]]
*1 [[Cookbook:Onion|onion]], [[Cookbook:Chopping|chopped]]
*1 green [[Cookbook:Bell Pepper|bell pepper]], chopped 
*1 can (15 oz) sweet [[Cookbook:Corn|corn]] kernels, drained
*1 can (15 oz) [[Cookbook:Black Bean|black beans]], drained
*1 can (14.5 oz) peeled and diced [[Cookbook:Tomato|tomatoes]] with juice
*¼ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] [[Cookbook:Salsa|salsa]]
*¼ cup sliced black [[Cookbook:Olive|olives]], drained
*1 ½ [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] taco seasoning mix
*[[Cookbook:Salt|Salt]], to taste
*[[Cookbook:Pepper|Pepper]], to taste

==Procedure==

#In a large pot bring 1 [[Cookbook:Quart|quart]] of lightly-salted water to a [[Cookbook:Boiling|boil]].
#Add pasta and cook for 8–10 minutes until pasta is [[Cookbook:Al Dente|al dente]]; drain water.
#While pasta is cooking, heat olive oil in a large [[Cookbook:Frying Pan|frying pan]] over medium heat.
#Cook onions and bell pepper in oil until lightly browned, about 10 minutes.
#Stir in corn, beans, tomatoes, salsa, olives, taco seasoning, salt and pepper. Cook until thoroughly heated, about 5 minutes.
#[[Cookbook:Mixing#Tossing|Toss]] heated vegetables into pasta, mix well and serve.
#Serve warm or cold.
